# dynamoxy

> A typed, async DynamoDB ORM for Python (3.12+) with a Rust core: models with `Attr[T]` fields or pydantic, repositories, queries with cursors, transactions, unique constraints, optimistic locking, single-table design, OpenTelemetry, and an in-memory DynamoDB for tests.

Read the usage guide first; it ships with the package (`dynamoxy guide`) and always matches the installed version.

## Usage

- [Usage guide (AGENT_GUIDE.md)](python/dynamoxy/AGENT_GUIDE.md): rules of thumb, a complete program, recipes for every feature, errors, observability, testing, limits
- [Skill for application repositories](skills/dynamoxy/SKILL.md): non-negotiable rules and a skeleton
- [Examples](examples/README.md): runnable programs (quickstart, single-table design, transactions, unique constraints, pydantic, repository pattern, pagination, observability, testing)
- [Guides](docs/index.md): modeling, reading, writing, constraints, transactions, single-table design, tables, errors and retries, observability, testing, patterns, deployment
